about: Every place the estate decided what words MEAN by matching them, from the word-matching audit of 23 Sep 2026 (class i: a decision about meaning that must become reasoning). founder_instruction 886-903: 'NO word matching anywhere'. 'migrated' = the meaning now comes from _shared/think.ts and its 'proof' is enforced by scripts/checks/decision_points_are_reasoned.test.mjs. 'pending' = still word-decided, in the order they will be migrated (customer-facing and money first). A regex that guards OUR outgoing text, or parses a format, is not listed: the ruling permits it.

points.decides: summary ilike left(summary,40) -> a differently worded request was flagged possible_duplicate by substring
points.held: An identical summary is flagged at once (identity, not meaning). A differently worded sibling (same customer, category, 30 minutes) files inquiry.same_request in the sales_engineer queue (dedupe inquiry_dup:<id>); under the hold no flag is guessed, and fn_reason_apply_inquiry__same_request sets it when reasoned.

points.decides: a regex on the supplier's file label (iso|أيزو, insurance|liability|تأمين, manufacturer|authori[sz]|وكالة) decided which required document slot a supporting file fills
points.held: The label is asked about when it is saved (trg_supplier_document_subject_asked -> supplier_documents.subject in the sales_engineer queue, dedupe supdoc:<id>:<md5 label>; the 6 live files are asked once by the file). Until it is reasoned the file stays in the supplier's own list but fills no slot; nothing is classified by a word.

points.decides: decision_policy.legal_triggers substrings (position(trg in text)) and three shared long words with a worse institutional_memory headline -> escalation
points.held: Text whose meaning is not yet reasoned returns needs_reasoning (ceo.escalation_meaning, dedupe ceo.escalation:<md5 text>) and adds no reason; fn_decide files it in the CEO seat's queue and decides nothing. No escalation, to the founder least of all, on a word.

points.decides: the escalate/approve branches acted on fn_should_escalate's word matches, and the invite pool took any supplier whose category text CONTAINED the slug (like '%'||category||'%')
points.held: An escalate/approve on text not yet reasoned returns awaiting_reasoning with route_to ceo and writes no decision_record, log or task; the question waits in the CEO seat's queue and fn_reason_apply_ceo__escalation_meaning re-runs the decision on the reasoned meaning. The invite pool is exact list membership (no model).

points.decides: reason_note ~* 'off.?platform' (and supplier_response_watch.close_reason) -> the off-platform EXCLUSION, which declines the refund
points.held: Notes not yet read file ceo.refund_off_platform in the CEO seat's queue (dedupe refund_offp:<tx>:<md5 notes>); the exclusion is not assumed, item off_platform_engagement_reasoned (kind needs_reasoning) fails, and fn_ceo_refund_review returns waiting_on_reasoning: no approval, no decline, no cycle, no founder page. The platform's own default note asks nothing. The reasoned answer re-runs the review.

points.decides: os_responsibility words in the task text (position(), longest first) -> the owning OS and owner; two shared long words -> a (possibly blocking) collaboration rule applies
points.held: The responsibility (ceo.task_responsibility) and each collaboration rule (ceo.task_collaboration_rule) are filed in the CEO seat's queue; until reasoned no owner is recorded and no rule applies, and the review lists them under awaiting_reasoning. The apply routines record the ownership row / collaboration row when answered.
